reasoning: The icon clearly combines two people with a studio microphone in the foreground, directly signifying a podcast, interview, co-hosted show, or group voice chat. It is much more specific to multi-person audio conversations than a plain microphone or a plain people icon. At tiny sizes the two circular heads above the curved mic stand can briefly read as eyes and a mouth.
